effect.shortEffect: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.
effect.full: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

french.sv: L’Attaque du Pokémon augmente s’il subit l’effet du\ntalent Intimidation. Les capacités ou objets qui font\nchanger de Pokémon n’ont aucun effet sur lui.

english.sv: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

japanese.sv: いかく　されると　攻撃が　上がる。 ポケモンを　入れ替えさせる 技や　道具が　効かない。
